newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Packer donates A$1 million to war memorial.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Packer donates A$1 million to war memorial.

text.p: Australian media magnate Kerry Packer has donated A$1 million to the Australian War Memorial Foundation, the foundation's chairman, Sir Phillip Bennett, said in a statement on Monday.
These and other funds raised would allow substantial redevelopment of the memorial, Bennett said.
The money would be paid over five years.
